design.spatial_baseline: same unit-time, same start/goal: stay-put predicts current zone and zero route progress; compare actual t+3/t+10 zone and legal shortest-path progress.
design.stratification: game × side × unit type for route scores; compare recommendation with its own same-sample stay-put baseline. Game is the bootstrap cluster.
design.hp_control: for health changes only, compare actionable recommendation observations to no-action-evidence observations matched by game/side/unit type/initial HP band; descriptive association only.
design.target_control: identified target HP change is descriptive because no comparable target-bearing no-action counterfactual exists.
design.noncausal_warning: No controller command log exists. Observed movement/HP/target changes do not establish recommendation execution or benefit.
